mutations.name: the outro's settleBy is not passed to the sweep
kills: qa stage on a beat that fades out over its last second passes content-fill on an outro, whose settled sample comes before its fade
qa stage on a beat that fades out over its last second names a bridged beat's kind from its resolved component, so an OutroBeat settles before its fade too

mutations.name: the qa stage sweeps even when the variant sets sweep: false
kills: qa stage sampling samples the cue moments only when the variant sets sweep: false

mutations.name: the qa spec defaults to cue moments only
kills: qa stage spec sweep param sweeps unless a variant sets sweep: false, and refuses any other param
